description_for_human: Astronomy Picture of the Day, near-Earth asteroids and full-disc Earth images from NASA.
description_for_model: Astronomy Picture of the Day, near-Earth asteroids and full-disc Earth images from NASA.

functions.name: getApod
functions.description: Returns NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day (image or video) with title and an explanation written by an astronomer. Use date for a specific day, start_date and end_date for a range, or count for random pictures.

functions.name: getAsteroid
functions.description: Returns details for a single asteroid by its NASA JPL small body id (the id field returned by getAsteroidFeed), including all of its past and future close approaches.

functions.name: getAsteroidFeed
functions.description: Returns near-Earth asteroids by their closest approach date to Earth, including size, speed, miss distance and whether they are potentially hazardous. The date range can be at most 7 days.

functions.name: getEarthImages
functions.description: Returns metadata for natural-color images of the whole sunlit side of Earth taken by NASA's EPIC camera on the DSCOVR satellite on the given date.
